notes: Variant (a): removed openai from the embeddings fallback chain in config/default.yml (fallback_models was parsed but never read by the router -- a fallback call reused Gemini's model name against OpenAI's API and always 404'd, and fixing that wiring would have surfaced the latent 1536-vs-768-dim mismatch instead). Documented the honest no-reserve decision in the YAML comment, docs/FUNCTIONALITY.md's provider table, and a router.py comment warning a future re-add of the fallback to mirror generate_text()'s index-aware model selection first. Added a cheap vector-length guard in RAGMemoryService.store() (before repo.store()) refusing to persist an embedding whose length != chat_memory's vector(768) column, logging provider/model on mismatch. Unit tests: config regression (embeddings.fallback/fallback_models now empty in real YAML), router regression (Gemini failure raises without ever calling a registered-but-not-in-chain openai provider), and two RAGMemoryService tests for the new guard (wrong-dim rejected + repo.store not called; correct-dim stored). Full unit suite (1730 tests) + ruff + mypy clean. Note for PM: S2-10 (background embedding backfill worker) depends on this and still needs the store() error-path change (write NULL-embedding rows) described in its scope note -- not touched here, out of S2-1's variant-(a) scope.
